page: Microsoft Azure EC32ads_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor, paired with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance includes 1229 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, meaning all workloads rely entirely on the dedicated AMD CPU resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC32ads_v5 offers a high resource density of memory and local solid-state storage relative to its CPU allocation. This makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, and applications requiring fast local scratch space, though the lack of dedicated GPU hardware limits its applicability for accelerated computing tasks.
